dn19:30.2: ‘ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa, yena jotipālo nāma māṇavo tenupasaṅkama. upasaṅkamitvā jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ evaṃ vadehi:
dn19:30.3: bhavamatthu bhavantaṃ jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ, rājā disampati bhavantaṃ jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantayati, rājā disampati bhoto jotipālassa māṇavassa dassanakāmo’ti.
dn19:30.4: ‘evaṃ devā’ti kho bho so puriso disampatissa rañño paṭissutvā yena jotipālo māṇavo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ etadavoca:
dn19:30.5: “bhavamatthu bhavantaṃ jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ, rājā disampati bhavantaṃ jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantayati, rājā disampati bhoto jotipālassa māṇavassa dassanakāmo”ti.
dn19:30.6: ‘evaṃ bho’ti kho so jotipālo māṇavo tassa purisassa paṭissutvā yena rājā disampati tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā disampatinā raññā saddhiṃ sammodi,
dn19:30.7: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho bho jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ rājā disampati etadavoca:
dn19:30.8: “anusāsatu no bhavaṃ jotipālo, mā no bhavaṃ jotipālo anusāsaniyā paccabyāhāsi,
dn19:30.9: pettike taṃ ṭhāne ṭhapessāmi, govindiye abhisiñcissāmī”ti.
dn19:30.10: ‘evaṃ bho’ti kho so jotipālo māṇavo disampatissa rañño paccassosi.
dn19:31.1: atha kho bho rājā disampati jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ govindiye abhisiñci, pettike ṭhāne ṭhapesi.
dn19:31.2: abhisitto jotipālo māṇavo govindiye, pettike ṭhāne ṭhapito, ye’pi’ssa pitā atthe anusāsi tepi atthe anusāsati, ye’pi’ssa pitā atthe nānusāsi te’pi atthe anusāsati,
dn19:31.3: ye’pi’ssa pitā kammante abhisambhosi, te’pi kammante abhisambhoti, ye’pi’ssa pitā kammante nābhisambhosi te’pi kammante abhisambhoti.
dn19:31.5: “govindo vata bho brāhmaṇo, mahāgovindo vata bho brāhmaṇo”ti.
dn19:31.6: iminā kho evaṃ bho pariyāyena jotipālassa māṇavassa govindo mahāgovindo’tveva samaññā udapādi.
dn19:32.1: atha kho bho mahāgovindo brāhmaṇo yena te cha khattiyā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā te cha khattiye etadavoca:

dn19:38.1: atha kho bho mahāgovindassa brāhmaṇassa aparena samayena evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggañchi”

dn19:38.4: mayhaṃ kho evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato.
dn19:38.5: sakkhi mahāgovindo brāhmaṇo brahmānaṃ passati, sakkhi mahāgovindo brāhmaṇo brahmunā sākaccheti sallapati mantetī’ti.

dn19:44.1: atha kho bho brahmā sanaṃkumāro mahāgovindassa brāhmaṇassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya, seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evameva brahmaloke antarahito mahāgovindassa brāhmaṇassa sammukhe pāturahosi.

dn19:61.4: taṃ kho pana me pañcasikha, brahmacariyaṃ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāvadeva brahma lokūpapattiyā.
dn19:61.5: idaṃ kho pana me pañcasikha, brahmacariyaṃ ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati’ti.
dn19:61.6: katamañca taṃ pañcasikha, brahmacariyaṃ ekanta nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati?
dn19:61.8: seyyathidaṃ? sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

dn19:62.1: ye kho pana me pañcasikha sāvakā sabbena sabbaṃ sāsanaṃ ājānanti, te āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.
dn19:62.2: ye na sabbena sabbaṃ sāsanaṃ ājānanti, te pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā honti, tattha parinibbāyino anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā.
dn19:62.3: ye na sabbena sabbaṃ sāsanaṃ ājānanti, appekacce tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā tanuttā sakadāgāmino honti, sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ rāgadosamohānaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissanti.
dn19:62.4: ye na sabbena sabbaṃ sāsanaṃ ājānanti appekacce tiṇṇaṃ saññoyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpannā honti avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā.
dn19:62.5: iti kho pañcasikha, sabbesaṃ yeva imesaṃ kulaputtānaṃ amoghā pabbajjā avañjhā saphalā saudrayā”ti.
